measurement_refresh.interpretation: Observed warmed per-shot latency for sequential baseline and candidate processes. Each sample follows a full GC outside measurement. These are not sustained-throughput measurements. The shared host was not reserved. Polling cannot exclude all intervening activity. ps CPU percentages are lifetime averages, not interval utilization.

comparison.state_scope_note: Some fixtures were not compared with full simulation state (state_comparison is not "full") and those results are not complete simulation-state agreement: "not_captured" and "scope_mismatch" are event/result agreement only, and "partial" means the capture is missing per-step snapshots (a coverage failure).

volatile_policy.note: No volatile exemptions exist: VOLATILE_ANIMATION_FIELDS is intentionally empty. snapshot.fever_buckets.animating and snapshot.fever_buckets.dividers[].y are authoritative (snapshot.fever_buckets.dividers feed Physics.update collision geometry; animating gates the per-step bucket/divider update), so any observed difference is an authoritative state_bit_difference/state_structure failure or an explicitly unresolved determinism finding requiring investigation. Allowlist additions require review.
